title: Crisp Review (2026)
intro: Crisp is evaluated here as a live chat and omnichannel messaging support platform — Crisp is an omnichannel customer messaging platform with live chat, shared inbox, and Hugo AI agent. Flat per-workspace pricing: Free (2 seats); Mini $45; Essentials $95; Plus $295/mo. Primary live-chat; CS secondary. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology, scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research (crisp.chat, 2026-09-06), not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Crisp when you want flat per-workspace live chat and shared inbox economics — not when you need deep ITSM ticketing or Text-style per-person chat packaging.
verdict: Choose Crisp when flat workspace pricing plus Hugo AI credits and omnichannel Essentials+ depth fit your support team. Compare Tidio for conversation-pack Lyro deflection and LiveChat for Text per-person seats. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-09-06 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging and Hugo credit burn on the vendor site before purchase.

faq.question: Does Crisp have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes — Crisp Free includes 2 seats and a website chat widget without Hugo AI credits. Confirm current limits on crisp.chat/en/pricing.

faq.question: How is Crisp priced compared with Tidio?
faq.answer: Crisp uses flat per-workspace fees; Tidio uses conversation-pack pricing. Convert carefully using expected agents vs billable conversations.

sections.heading: What Crisp is for
sections.body: Crisp positions as an all-in-one customer messaging workspace: website chat, shared inbox, and Hugo AI for startups and SMBs. The editorial fit is live-chat support first, with omnichannel depth rising on Essentials and Plus — not a sales CRM and not an ITSM suite.

sections.heading: Pricing model
sections.body: Published flat workspace pricing (verified 2026-09-06): Free $0 (2 seats), Mini $45 (4 seats, $5 Hugo credits), Essentials $95 (10 seats, $25 credits), Plus $295 (20+ seats, $75 credits). Extra seats are $10/month. A 14-day trial is advertised. Hugo usage beyond included credits is metered — treat AI cost as a second line item.

sections.heading: How Crisp differs from Tidio and LiveChat
sections.body: Versus Tidio, Crisp competes on workspace-flat economics and stronger documented omnichannel/KB depth on paid tiers, while Tidio leans conversation-pack Lyro deflection. Versus LiveChat, Crisp avoids Text per-person seat ladders but also lacks Text HelpDesk/ChatBot suite adjacency. Prefer based on pricing unit and channel breadth — not logo familiarity.

testingNotes: No SoftwareGlimpse hands-on lab session. Research-only review.
